Senior Software Engineer - Data License Analytics, Pune
Location
Pune
Business Area
Engineering and CTO
Ref #
10055152
Description & Requirements
About the Team
Data License is Bloomberg's enterprise data delivery platform, powering financial institutions worldwide with reference, pricing, regulatory, and alternative data — covering over 50 million securities across portfolio accounting, risk, compliance, and trading use cases.
The DL Analytics Platform is the intelligence and reliability layer of this ecosystem. We build the data ingestion pipelines, embeddings infrastructure, AI agents, and MCP tool servers that give engineers and LLMs structured, query able access to operational data. Our systems power incident triage, semantic search over tickets and documentation, pipeline health analytics, and self-service data onboarding for partner teams across Data License.
We are expanding our engineering presence into Pune and the broader APAC region — a greenfield initiative where engineers will collaborate closely with colleagues in Dublin, London, and New York, helping shape the culture and technical direction of this hub from day one.
What's the role?
You'll join a team at the intersection of data infrastructure, reliability engineering, and applied AI — building systems that make Bloomberg's data delivery more reliable, intelligent, and scalable.
Reliability Engineering: GenAI-powered tooling for incident triage, root-cause analysis, and blast radius assessment — exposing live pipeline data to LLM agents via MCP tool servers.
Data Analytics & AI: Ingestion pipelines into Apache Iceberg, semantic search over operational data using vector databases and embedding models, and automated KPI tracking to surface platform health and anomalies.
We'll trust you to:
- Build GenAI tools and AI agents — RAG pipelines, contextual embedding systems, and MCP tool servers that give LLM agents structured access to live pipeline data
- Build and maintain data ingestion pipelines into Apache Iceberg, orchestrated via Apache Airflow
- Develop semantic search capabilities using vector databases and hosted embedding models
- Build self-service ingestion APIs enabling partner teams to onboard to the platform without managing Iceberg or storage infrastructure
- Design microservices and backend APIs — with opportunities to contribute to React/TypeScript interfaces embedded in production tools
- Instrument systems with OpenTelemetry and contribute to anomaly detection capabilities on the near-term roadmap
Technologies
- Languages & Frameworks: Python (3.11 / 3.12 / 3.13), TypeScript, FastAPI, React
- Data & Orchestration: Apache Iceberg, Apache Airflow, PyArrow, PyIceberg, Spark, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Parquet
- Databases: PostgreSQL, vector databases, Redis, Solr, distributed SQL
- Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, NGINX, OpenTelemetry
- Cloud: GCP, AWS (S3, Redshift), Snowflake, Databricks
- AI & ML: RAG frameworks, embedding models, contextual chunking, semantic search, LLM integration
- Agent Frameworks: MCP (Model Context Protocol), Agent-to-Agent (A2A)
You'll need to have:
- 6+ Software engineering experience in production environments
- Proficiency in Python or a similar language
- Familiarity with relational databases and SQL
- Interest or experience in data engineering — pipelines, batch processing, or data lake technologies
- Understanding of distributed systems and service architecture
- Interest in AI/ML — particularly LLMs, RAG, or embedding-based search
We'd love to see:
- Experience with Apache Iceberg, PyArrow, or data lake engineering
- Familiarity with Apache Airflow or workflow orchestration
- Experience with vector databases, embedding models, or semantic search
- Background in anomaly detection or data quality frameworks
- Exposure to MCP, A2A, or agent communication protocols
- Experience with observability tooling — tracing, metrics, structured logging
- Curiosity about financial data and reliability engineering
Why Join Us
- Ship GenAI tooling used daily in production — MCP servers, RAG pipelines, and AI agents for real incident triage
- Be a founding member of a greenfield engineering hub — shape the culture and standards from day one
- Collaborate with engineers across Dublin, London, and New York
- Work at scale — millions of securities, billions of data points, clients depending on it around the clock
- Join a team that values curiosity, learning, and measurable impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing high-performance, scalable, and resilient backend storage solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure. You will be responsible for developing distributed storage systems, APIs, and backend services that power mission-critical applications, ensuring low-latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data storage. In this role, you will also be responsible for troubleshooting and resolving production incidents related to data integrity, latency spikes, and storage failures, ensuring high availability and disaster recovery preparedness. You will mentor junior engineers, participate in design reviews and architectural discussions, and advocate for engineering best practices such as CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, and observability-driven development. Your contributions will directly impact the organization's ability to scale its storage infrastructure efficiently while maintaining security, reliability, and compliance with industry standards.

Hands-On with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & DevOps

Your role
The Engineer develops technology capabilities and services that Product teams use to build customer-facing solutions, expediting the delivery of technology-enabled value to the Business. They develop and/or configure technologies to meet technical requirements and architecture, whilst ensuring the services they build are robust, maintainable, reusable, and highly scalable. Engineer has ownership of end-to-end data pipelines (semantic layer -> bespoke layer), do architectural decision within Azure Data Platform, owns non-functional requirements such as performance improvement, cost reduction and security standards, providing long-term technical direction for data engineering within Product Team.
Main Responsibilities
- Designs, configures, develops, builds, tests, and releases end‑to‑end Azure‑based data solutions and services that meet functional and non‑functional requirements, contributing to the delivery of high‑value, scalable Product increments.
- Leads the design and implementation of data engineering solutions and architectural components across the Azure Data Platform (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Snowflake, SAP BW, MuleSoft, Apigee), ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and best practices.
- Acts as a technical authority for data engineering, collaborating closely with Product Owners, Platform Owners, Platform Architects, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust, maintainable, and cost‑efficient data solutions.
- Owns complex incidents, defects, and escalations, identifying root causes and driving sustainable fixes across data pipelines, platforms, and integrations.
- Delivers secure, high‑quality, production‑grade code, ensuring compliance with security, data governance, and engineering standards, and proactively addressing performance, reliability, and scalability concerns.
- Proactively identifies and drives resolution of technical debt, makes independent technical decisions, clearly communicates trade‑offs (e.g. cost, performance, complexity), and serves as the primary point of contact for data engineering topics within the Product or Platform area.
- Defines and enforces data engineering standards and best practices, including data modelling approaches, coding standards, CI/CD patterns, monitoring, and documentation to support long‑term platform sustainability.
- Mentors and supports other engineers, providing technical guidance, design and code reviews, and knowledge sharing to raise overall data engineering maturity within the team.
- Documents architectures, solutions, and operational procedures to ensure maintainability, supportability, and effective handover across teams.
- Applies Agile principles and ways of working to efficiently design, deliver, and continuously improve data solutions (e.g., Kanban), while influencing ways of working through experience and continuous improvement initiatives.
- Drives a culture of continuous improvement, actively contributing to enhancements in data platform stability, performance, observability, and cost optimisation.
- Supports and fulfils advanced Product and Platform service requests, such as access strategy, solution insights, data quality investigations, and platform optimisation activities.
To Succeed, You Will Need
- Proven track record of independently delivering and owning high‑quality, secure, and scalable technology solutions that meet complex functional and non‑functional requirements within modern Azure‑based data architectures.
- Advanced experience with end‑to‑end solution quality assurance, including data validation, automated testing strategies, performance testing, and production readiness to ensure long‑term scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
- Deep, hands‑on expertise in the Azure Data Platform, including design, development, and operation of data pipelines and platforms using technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Databricks, Delta Lake, Snowflake, and related Azure services.
- Strong experience designing and applying DevOps and DataOps practices for data platforms, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure‑as‑code, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and release management (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Git‑based workflows).
- Strong understanding of software engineering principles, cloud architecture, information risk, data security, and governance, with the ability to apply these principles pragmatically in complex, enterprise‑scale environments.
- Extensive hands‑on experience in modern programming and scripting languages commonly used in data engineering (e.g., Python, SQL, PySpark; additional languages such as Java or .NET beneficial), with a strong focus on readable, maintainable, and performant code.
- Recognised senior‑level engineering expertise in data engineering and cloud platforms, demonstrated through successful ownership of production systems, architectural decision‑making, mentoring of other engineers, and, where applicable, relevant professional certifications (e.g., Azure Data Engineer, Cloud Solution Architect).
- Experience working effectively across Agile and hybrid delivery models, including Agile (e.g., Kanban / Scrum) and Waterfall environments, with the ability to influence engineering practices and continuously improve ways of working.
- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to assess trade‑offs (cost, performance, complexity, risk), make sound technical decisions, and clearly communicate reasoning to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
- AI‑aware data engineering mindset, with practical understanding of how Azure data platforms enable machine learning and generative AI workloads (e.g. data preparation for ML, feature engineering, model serving integration, and consumption of AI outputs within data solutions).

Mumbai | 2–4 years experience | [Hybrid, X days a week in office / On-site]
We're the Commercial Enablement team at a large pharmaceutical company in India. We build and run the digital products our field force uses every day : sales performance tracking, incentive calculations, distributor and channel platforms, and the reporting that leadership looks at every week.
All of it runs on data, and we need people to build and look after that data layer properly.
What the job is
You'll build the pipelines that pull data from our sales, CRM, HR and external market sources, clean it up, model it, and make it available to dashboards and applications. Then you'll keep them running. This isn't a project role where you hand over and move on. You'll own what you build once it's in production.
You'll sit inside the product team, not in a central IT function. That means you'll hear directly from the people using the numbers, you'll be part of the discussion when requirements are set, and you'll know when something you built is being used in a leadership review.
What you'll own :
- Building and maintaining ingestion and transformation pipelines across multiple source systems
- Handling the messy stuff : late data, backdated corrections, restated months, duplicates
- Working on the commercial data model, including keeping history accurate when sales territories, managers, products or reporting lines change
- Putting data quality checks, monitoring and alerts in place so problems are caught before they reach a payout or a leadership review
- Troubleshooting when something breaks or two numbers don't match, finding the root cause, and fixing it properly
- Writing things down so the next person can understand them
What you'll get exposure to as you grow :
- Tuning queries and storage as we scale from a regional rollout to all of India
- Moving legacy data onto our cloud platform
- Reviewing what our vendors build and pushing back when it isn't good enough
- Working with our IT team on infrastructure, security and access
Owning pipelines in production means occasionally being the person who looks at a failure outside normal hours, usually around month-end or payout cycles. [Adjust or remove based on actual support arrangement.]
Who we're looking for
2 to 4 years working with data, including at least a year of hands-on work building or maintaining production pipelines that people depend on. You've worked with large datasets and you've had to make something faster or more reliable.
You don't need an engineering degree. Some of the best people we've come across in this space started in commerce, finance or economics and moved into data through certifications or simply by doing the work. If you've built real pipelines, we'd like to hear from you.
You may be a good fit if :
- You started on the business side (sales analytics, inventory, ERP) and moved into data engineering
- You're a data analyst or data scientist who ended up building the pipelines behind your own work and found you liked that part more
- You're a data engineer who wants to be closer to the business and the people using your work
Must have :
- Strong SQL. Comfortable with window functions and CTEs, and able to work out why a query is slow
- Python for transformation and validation work
- Experience building and running batch pipelines in production
- Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud data platform. We don't mind which one
- A working understanding of dimensional modelling : star schemas, grain, slowly changing dimensions
- Git, and some familiarity with testing and deploying changes to data pipelines
Good to have :
- Spark or another distributed processing framework
- Experience with an orchestration tool
- Enough experience with a BI tool to build datasets that reports can actually run on
- Streaming pipelines
- Experience in pharma, healthcare, BFSI or another regulated industry
- Some exposure to forecasting or predictive models, so you understand what downstream users need from your data
- Experience migrating legacy systems to the cloud
The right person is careful about getting numbers right, comfortable telling a stakeholder something isn't ready yet, able to explain a technical problem without jargon, and happy to take real ownership in a small team.
What we'd expect
In your first three months, get to know how data flows through our systems and take over at least one production pipeline. By six months, have quality checks and monitoring running on everything you own. By the end of your first year, you should be independently owning a meaningful part of the commercial data model and contributing to its rollout across India.
A lot of what this team produces ends up in people's incentive payouts and in leadership reviews. When the data is wrong, people notice. We need someone who takes that seriously.

About This Role

Location: Mumbai, India

Your team
The Alternative Data Pipeline Engineering team supports Aladdin, BlackRock's investment management and technology platform, by building and operating reliable data products that acquire, transform, model, and distribute diverse datasets for investment, analytics, and platform use cases. The team partners across engineering, product, data specialists, and data consumers, with a focus on making high-quality data reliably and efficiently available.
Your role and impact
As a Data Engineer, you will build and support enterprise data pipelines and data platforms that enable scalable processing of structured and semi-structured data. You will apply strong Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) skills and work with Snowflake and modern data engineering technologies to deliver solutions from requirements and technical design through implementation, deployment, and production support. Your work will improve the quality, observability, reliability, and maintainability of production data products while simplifying how new datasets are onboarded and processed.
Your Responsibilities
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
- Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain production-grade data pipelines and reusable ingestion and transformation components for structured and semi-structured data.
- Develop scalable data models and extract, load, and transform (ELT) transformations, using advanced SQL to support complex workloads while optimizing performance, scalability, and cost.
- Develop and operate reliable directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing while implementing automated data-quality checks, reconciliation, lineage, alerting, monitoring, and failure handling.
- Build modular, maintainable, well-tested solutions and improve engineering productivity through reusable frameworks, automation, and responsibly governed artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted development.
- Partner with product teams, data specialists, and consumers to translate requirements into dependable solutions, taking end-to-end ownership and communicating progress, risks, and issues.
- Diagnose production issues and improve reliability, observability, and resilience while contributing to modernization and migration of existing data pipelines to BlackRock's enterprise data platform.
Your Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with at least 4 years of hands-on experience building and supporting enterprise data pipelines, platforms, or data-intensive applications.
- Strong Python development skills with experience in modular design, error handling, logging, automated testing, Git-based development, peer review, and continuous integration and continuous delivery practices.
- Advanced SQL and strong hands-on Snowflake experience, including complex transformations, schema design, semi-structured data, ELT patterns, query troubleshooting, and performance and cost optimization.
- Practical experience developing and troubleshooting data workflows, combined with a strong understanding of data warehousing and modeling concepts, including dimensional and historical data design.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to diagnose complex data and production issues and take ownership in an agile, globally distributed environment.
- Experience with large-scale distributed data analytics engines and exposure to modern transformation, application programming interface (API), data-format, distributed event streaming and messaging, and Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud technologies.
- Experience with reusable data-engineering capabilities, governance and lineage, cloud or legacy modernization, financial or alternative data, and secure AI-assisted software development is beneficial.
Our Benefits
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
Our hybrid work model
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
About BlackRock
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

- As a Data Engineering Director, you will provide hands-on technical and architectural leadership for the data capabilities underpinning SIGNAL. You will help define the architecture, establish engineering standards, and work closely with teams from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery and adoption.
- A key part of the role is rapidly learning and leveraging BlackRock’s internally developed Data Platform as a Service (dPaaS) capabilities. You will champion a reuse-first approach, extending existing platform capabilities where appropriate before building new solutions.
- You will lead engineering across structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data, creating trusted, reusable, and AI-ready data products that power applications, analytics, generative AI, and agentic experiences.
Your Responsibilities
- In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
- Define and evolve SIGNAL’s target-state data architecture and provide hands-on engineering leadership from technical discovery and prototyping through production delivery.
- Rapidly learn and leverage internal Data Platform as a Service (dPaaS) capabilities, making pragmatic reuse, extension, or build decisions based on scalability, interoperability, business outcomes, and speed to market.
- Architect scalable integration and processing across client, product, sales, marketing, servicing, behavioral, and external data, spanning batch and real-time workloads, application programming interfaces (APIs), workflow orchestration, and event streaming.
- Design structured and unstructured data capabilities including ingestion, parsing, metadata extraction, chunking, indexing, search, semantic retrieval, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
- Establish engineering standards for data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, observability, security, resilience, and performance.
- Build reusable data services for applications, analytics, AI models, agents, and downstream platforms while partnering across product, platform, AI, governance, engineering, and business teams to drive delivery and adoption.
- Mentor engineers and foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, collaboration, and accountability.
Your Experience
- Demonstrated experience in data engineering, data architecture, distributed systems, or large-scale software engineering, including delivery of scalable enterprise data platforms and products.
- Strong hands-on engineering skills in Python, Java and/or Scala, SQL, Snowflake, and dbt, with experience in distributed data processing, batch and real-time pipelines, APIs, event streaming, and workflow orchestration.
- Ability to rapidly learn and leverage internal platforms and dPaaS capabilities, applying strong architectural judgment across scalability, reliability, security, cost, maintainability, and speed.
- Experience with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data and AI-ready architectures, including document processing, metadata extraction, semantic search, embeddings, vector retrieval, knowledge graphs, and RAG.
- Strong knowledge of data modeling, data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, security, observability, and production engineering.
- Experience with Microsoft Azure, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, containerized environments, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and infrastructure automation, with exposure to generative AI, machine learning, semantic technologies, and agentic architectures.
- Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across teams, communicate effectively with senior technology and business stakeholders, and mentor and develop engineering talent.
Our Benefits
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
Our hybrid work model
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
Guidance on AI use for candidates
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
About BlackRock
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

- 5+ years of relevant software development experience, including Python 3.x, Django/Flask Frameworks, FastAPI (or other standard industry API), and relational databases (SQL/ORM).

- Experience with conceptual, logical, and/or physical database designs.
- Strong SQL experience, specifically writing complex, highly optimized queries across large volumes of data.
- Strong data modeling/profiling capabilities using Kimball/star schema methodology as well as medallion architecture.
- Professional experience with Kafka, EventHub or other live streaming technologies.

Job Title: Senior Python Engineer — Technical Lead

About Business line/Function: The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management.
Position Purpose
You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control’s execution engine and the subsequent modules.
This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to — code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation — and who onboards the engineers who join after you.
Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard.
Responsibilities
Direct Responsibilities
- To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production.
- Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs.
- Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails.
- Asynchronous processing — background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation.
- Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers.
Specific Qualifications
Technical Skills:
- Strong command of modern Python (3.11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts.
- Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications.
- SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL — complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred.
- Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover.
- Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging.
- Automated testing as a matter of routine — unit and integration — with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest.
- Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories.
- Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively.
- Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential.
Nice To Have
- Identity and access management domain knowledge — entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint.
- Workflow orchestration — Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys.
- Front-end capability — server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular.
- Asynchronous task frameworks — Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker.
- Regulated-environment experience — delivery within a bank or other regulated institution, including change management, security assessment and penetration testing cycles.
- Reporting and analytics — designing data models consumed by Power BI or a comparable tool
Behavioral Skills
-
- Self-motivated and passionate about delivering exceptional results, with a strong desire to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution.
- Platform Thinking & Ownership: Ability to think holistically about the platform, considering the interactions and dependencies between different components and systems.

Job Description
Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?
Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.
Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and integration solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to power enterprise Data & Analytics (D&A) products — including inbound/outbound data flows, analytics-ready datasets, and reporting workloads. Play a key role in the planned Databricks migration (mid-2027), shaping architecture decisions, conducting POCs, and leading the technical transition while maintaining uninterrupted service on the current GCP stack.
How You Will Contribute
You will:
- You will design and deliver data solutions that are optimised to meet business demands, driving continuous improvement across the D&A data enablement landscape.
- You will play a central role in transitioning the team's platform from GCP-native services to Databricks, ensuring architectural soundness and operational continuity throughout the migration.
- You will recommend actions to optimize data infrastructure investments, mitigate data-quality and reliability risks, and enable faster, more trustworthy analytics for the business.
- This role will also require you to collaborate with vendor partners, support vendor governance activities, work with project resources to design and configure data components aligned with security policy and governance and ensure adherence to engineering standards and processes.
What You Will Bring
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
- Using data analysis to make recommendations to analytic leaders
- Understanding in best-in-class analytics practices
- Knowledge of Indicators (KPI's) and scorecards
- Knowledge of BI tools like Tableau, Excel, Alteryx, R, Python, etc. is a plus
More About This Role
What you need to know about this position:
Data Engineering & Pipeline Development
- Design, develop, and maintain robust, production-grade data pipelines (batch and near-real-time) on GCP using BigQuery, Cloud Composer (Airflow), Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Functions, and Pub/Sub.
- Build and maintain inbound and outbound data integration layers, handling data ingestion from diverse source systems and delivering curated datasets to downstream consumers (analytics platforms, reporting tools, business applications).
- Develop and enforce data transformation logic (cleansing, enrichment, aggregation, reconciliation) to ensure data accuracy and consistency across the D&A estate.
- Implement orchestration frameworks using tools such as Talend, Aecorsoft, or Cloud Composer, ensuring reliable scheduling, dependency management, error handling, and retry mechanisms.
Databricks Migration & Modernisation
- Serve as a technical lead for the planned migration from GCP-native services to Databricks, partnering with architecture and product teams to define the target-state platform.
- Conduct proof-of-concept (POC) builds on Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, Workflows) to validate migration patterns, performance benchmarks, and cost models.
- Develop migration playbooks, mapping current pipelines and data objects to their Databricks equivalents, and execute phased cutovers with minimal business disruption.
- Establish Databricks best practices for the team — including notebook standards, cluster policies, job configurations, and lakehouse design patterns.
Data Quality & Governance
- Integrate data quality checks into pipeline workflows; collaborate with the DQ function (e.g. Ataccama) to operationalise rules, thresholds, and alerting at the pipeline level.
- Support data governance activities — cataloguing, lineage documentation, metadata management — and ensure adherence to defined SLAs for governed data objects.
- Monitor data freshness, completeness, and accuracy signals; proactively surface and remediate data anomalies before they impact downstream consumers.
Operational Excellence & Reliability
- Own L2/L3 support for data pipelines and engineering workloads within the D&A portfolio; participate in incident triage, root-cause analysis, and post-incident corrective actions.
- Build and maintain observability — monitoring dashboards, alerting, and runbooks — to reduce Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) for pipeline failures and data SLA misses.
- Apply infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform) for environment provisioning, IAM, networking, and resource management on GCP.
- Embed FinOps discipline: enforce resource tagging/labelling, identify and remediate waste (idle resources, oversized clusters, runaway jobs), and contribute to cost-optimization initiatives.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
- Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams — analytics engineers, reporting specialists (Power BI), business stakeholders, and vendor partners — to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
- Mentor and guide junior engineers within the team; conduct code reviews, share best practices, and contribute to the team's technical uplift.
- Participate in vendor governance activities, supporting evaluation, onboarding, and management of technology and service partners.
What extra ingredients you will bring:
- Building and operating production data pipelines on GCP at enterprise scale
- Navigating platform migrations (cloud-to-cloud or technology stack transitions) with minimal business disruption
- Working collaboratively with multiple vendors and cross-functional teams
- Leading technical initiatives and mentoring junior engineers
- Stakeholder management and the ability to influence technical direction
- Managing data engineering services delivery, support, and operational excellence
- Working in a global IT function with regional or global responsibilities in an environment like Mondelēz International
- Working effectively with IT outsource partners and transitioning work from partner to internal teams
Education / Certifications:
Bachelor's Degree or PG
Job specific requirements:
- 8+ years of hands-on data engineering experience with at least 3 years on GCP.
- Strong GCP fundamentals: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer (Airflow), Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, IAM, Monitoring/Logging.
- Proficient in SQL and Python; experience with PySpark or Spark SQL is highly desirable.
- ETL/ELT pipeline design: proven ability to build, optimise, and troubleshoot complex data pipelines at scale.
- Databricks experience or strong interest: familiarity with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, or Spark-on-Databricks is a significant plus (hands-on POC experience preferred).
- Orchestration tools: experience with Talend, Aecorsoft, Apache Airflow, or similar.
- Infrastructure as Code: working knowledge of Terraform for GCP resource provisioning.
- CI/CD practices: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or equivalent; comfortable with PR-based workflows and automated testing.
- Data quality & governance: exposure to DQ tools (Ataccama, Great Expectations, or similar) and metadata/lineage management concepts.
- Observability & monitoring: ability to set up dashboards, alerts, and logging for pipeline health (Cloud Monitoring, Grafana, or Datadog).
- Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work under pressure during incidents.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences and collaborate across global teams.
Preferred Skills:
- Experience with Kubernetes/GKE for data workloads.
- Familiarity with data lakehouse architecture patterns.
- Exposure to ML pipeline support or feature engineering workflows.
- Security tooling awareness (Dependabot, SonarQube, Wiz, or similar).
- Bash scripting and Linux administration basics.
- Experience working in a global IT function (similar to Mondelēz International) with regional or global responsibilities.
No Relocation support available

Overview
You’ll build the data and pipelines that sit behind TIDE. Your work will help cyber and exposure data move in a clean and reliable way from source to product.

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.
Our Impact

Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts .
About the Role:
We are looking for an exceptional Staff Engineer to shape the architecture and evolution of our data infrastructure as we scale.
Our engineering ecosystem operates multiple database technologies, handles large volumes of data and traffic, and supports a growing number of services and engineering teams.
We need a strong individual contributor who has built and scaled distributed data systems, understands database technologies at a fundamental level, and can solve complex infrastructure challenges across multiple engineering teams.
This role goes beyond operating existing databases. You will design systems, build infrastructure capabilities, challenge architectural limitations, and drive technical initiatives that improve scalability, reliability, performance, and infrastructure economics.
What You'll Do:
- Architect for scale: Design and evolve distributed data architectures capable of supporting significant growth in traffic, data volume, and engineering complexity.
- Build infrastructure platforms: Develop reusable infrastructure components, frameworks, and platform capabilities that enable engineering teams to build scalable systems.
- Drive architectural evolution: Identify fundamental limitations in existing systems and lead large-scale initiatives involving data distribution, sharding, replication, migrations, and architectural modernization.
- Shape technical strategy: Influence database technology choices, architectural patterns, and long-term infrastructure direction across the company.
- Improve infrastructure economics: Lead engineering initiatives that materially improve scalability, resource efficiency, and infrastructure costs.
- Engineer for reliability: Design systems that remain available and resilient under high throughput, infrastructure failures, and changing workload patterns.
- Create organizational leverage: Establish engineering standards and reusable solutions that eliminate recurring problems across teams.
- Lead through technical influence: Work with senior engineers and engineering leadership to turn ambiguous, company-level challenges into executable technical programs.
What We're Looking For:
- 9+ years of strong software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience designing and building distributed systems, backend infrastructure, or large-scale data platforms, with demonstrated Staff-level technical impact.
- Strong software engineering background with experience designing and building production infrastructure, not only operating or administering it.
- Experience architecting systems handling multi-terabyte datasets and 30K–50K+ operations per second, or comparable large-scale distributed workloads.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts, including partitioning, sharding, replication, consistency, concurrency, fault tolerance, and data distribution.
- Strong hands-on experience with both relational and NoSQL database architectures, including their design principles, scalability characteristics, and trade-offs.
- Experience leading complex architectural initiatives involving multiple systems and engineering teams.
Ability to identify systemic technical problems and design solutions that improve infrastructure across the organization.
- Strong technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to influence architectural decisions without formal authority.
Tech Experience:
We value engineering depth and architectural understanding over familiarity with a long list of technologies.
Strong experience with relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL, combined with experience in one or more distributed database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar systems, is highly relevant.
Experience with distributed SQL, search infrastructure, analytical databases, or other large-scale storage systems is an advantage.
We do not expect expertise in any particular combination of database products. What matters is the ability to understand their internals, evaluate trade-offs, and design scalable infrastructure around them.
What Makes Someone Successful in This Role:
You have previously taken ownership of challenging infrastructure problems where the solution required more than improving an individual service or database.
You have designed or significantly evolved distributed architectures, built infrastructure adopted by multiple teams, led complex technical transformations, or enabled systems to operate at substantially greater scale.
You are equally comfortable discussing database internals, distributed systems trade-offs, and long-term architecture as you are working with engineers to turn those decisions into production systems.
Your impact is measured by the systems you enable, the architectural problems you eliminate, and the engineering capabilities you leave behind.

You will lead the architecture and production evolution of the dbt Cloud and Snowflake transformation layer that supports data products, analytics, and AI use cases for Global Customer Success. Your primary charter is to make the platform more economical and scalable as data volume, complexity, and consumption grow. You will combine expert ELT pipeline design with hands-on dbt optimization, operational job monitoring, and production release practices.
This is not a documentation-only architecture role. You will investigate expensive or fragile workloads, design reusable patterns, implement foundational solutions, and help engineers run their daily work in dbt effectively. You will also establish the delivery controls to fully orchestrate bronze/silver/gold layers into downstream data use.
Key Responsibilities
You will make an impact by
• Own the technical architecture and engineering standards for dbt Cloud transformations on Snowflake, including project structure, model layering, dependencies, testing, documentation, orchestration, and deployment patterns.
• Reduce the marginal compute cost of roadmap growth by analyzing query and job behavior, identifying inefficient transformations, and prioritizing the optimizations with the highest return.
• Design efficient approaches for complex, high-volume datasets, including appropriate model boundaries, incremental processing, materialization strategies, workload sizing, scheduling, and reuse of transformed data.
• Establish production-grade DEV, QUA, and PRD dbt job processes with CI/CD controls, automated validation, release gates, regression detection, rollback approaches, and auditable release documentation.
• Define operational monitoring for dbt mart distribution of data products, working closely with data scientists, dashboard developers, and AI application owners to ensure outputs are meeting their needs.
• Coach dbt data engineers and collaborate with the wider data team through design reviews, code reviews, reusable examples, technical documentation, and knowledge transfer while remaining hands-on with complex implementations.
Qualifications
• Advanced, hands-on expertise with dbt Cloud in production environments. Deep dbt capability is a non-negotiable requirement for this role.
• Demonstrated experience designing, refactoring, and optimizing large dbt projects and complex SQL transformations on Snowflake or a comparable cloud data platform.
• Strong knowledge of dbt model design, tests, macros, packages, documentation, lineage, orchestration, incremental models, snapshots, and materializations.
• Experience measuring and improving cloud data workload efficiency using query profiles, execution history, warehouse behavior, job telemetry, and cost or consumption data.
• Experience designing CI/CD and release-management practices for analytics engineering, including environment separation, automated checks, controlled promotion, regression handling, and rollback.
• Ability to translate business and data-product requirements into maintainable technical architecture and to communicate tradeoffs clearly across a global team.
Preferred Skills
• dbt certification or substantial evidence of advanced dbt practice.
• Expertise with managing Snowflake performance and cost optimization.
• Experience running transformations and data products for analytics, customer health, telemetry, or AI workloads.
• Experience establishing engineering standards in a growing data organization and establishing best practices.
• Familiarity with APIs, data contracts, semantic layers, metadata/catalog tools, and enterprise data governance.
What Success Looks Like
• Measurable reductions in normalized compute consumption, avoidable job runtime, and repeated transformation work.
• A documented and adopted set of reusable dbt patterns for efficient delivery.
• A functioning, controlled path from development through test to production, including regression and rollback practices.
• Improved reliability, observability, documentation, and maintainability of production dbt workloads.
• Greater internal dbt capability that can support a continuous increase in incoming requests and use cases.

- Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale data integration and transformation solutions.
- Experience across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
- Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
- Strong understanding of database performance tuning, schema versioning, and platform engineering best practices.
- Ability to make architectural trade-offs and deliver scalable solutions that meet evolving business needs.

- Experience with modern Azure data platform technologies including Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Integration Services.
